style.backgroundSystem: consistent walnut wood #6B4326 bookshelf space with a softly out-of-focus brass desk lamp, cream #F3EDE0 rounded paper panels as copy plates; no other environment
style.iconSystem: thin-line orange-gold #C8802A book-spine and bookmark symbols at uniform 2px stroke, used only as bullet markers, step numbers and callouts
style.lightingSystem: warm 4700K raking key from the upper left at 45 degrees, wide soft falloff, low-intensity fill from the right, believable contact shadows, matte paper without specular glare
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm reading-culture editorial ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy #16294A, cream paper #F3EDE0, walnut wood #6B4326 and one orange-gold accent #C8802A; warm tone; warm 4700K raking key light from the upper left at 45 degrees with soft falloff and believable contact shadows; consistent walnut bookshelf and blurred brass desk lamp background space; one bold heavy sans-serif type family for all rendered copy; consistent thin-line orange-gold book-spine icon style; stable book scale and centered placement with credible paper texture and board thickness; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brand name, shop name, publisher mark, series mark, author name, ISBN, barcode or QR code
no price, discount, coupon, page count, trim size, age rating, material grade, award or certification
no readable source on-image copy; all in-image Chinese is 「」 placeholder copy
no child biting, tearing, chewing or swallowing a page; no paper near a mouth
no identifiable child face; children shown from behind or cropped above the jawline
style.presentationRules: stable book scale across the set, product centered or on a clean third line, vertical edges kept perfectly vertical, cover geometry and slipcase proportions never restyled, contact shadow always present, one real object anchors scale in scene shots
style.surfaceSystem: oiled walnut shelf face #6B4326 as the recurring surface, warm cream uncoated paper #F3EDE0 for cards, inner spreads and slipcase faces
style.typography: one bold heavy sans-serif family for all rendered copy, headline 32-40pt, label 14-16pt; cream panels carry navy #16294A copy with short accents in #C8802A
